policy: Original printed stats; fixed independent frame poses and input-derived crops. Shared set geometry with filled light ink and separately thinned lower-right shadow. Fixed ink palette, material/name-balanced contrast, filled area, edge overlap and stroke-width error. V3 preserves V2 fitted values and replaces the font’s blank mathematical minus with its visible en dash. Existing validation names were previously reviewed; this is repeated validation, not fresh generalization evidence. No per-card geometry.

notes: All 33 V2 examples visually reviewed. V3 retains identical geometry and ink except Shapeshifter’s visible en dash; that glyph and the additional Wall of Spears example were inspected.
Fixed palette retained; residual pigment, scan grain and glyph differences remain separate from placement.
Grave Robbers stats are displaced relative to its frozen frame pose. Its measured regression is retained, without a per-card override.

limitations: Five stat-bearing scans have unresolved frame poses and are excluded from regional fitting/scoring. Three ordinary-frame cards still use the shared set default; the two unresolved DRK gold creatures remain unchanged.
Grave Robbers retains a local contrast regression and needs independent print/scan displacement review. No per-card correction is applied.
The light/dark pigment is the existing palette, not a new photometric ink calibration. Residual font/stroke and texture differences remain visible.

The whole-card report uses the application’s existing fixed stats crop, which clips the leading portion of long expressions; this regional fit uses complete input-derived text crops. The whole-card similarity index is not a correctness percentage.

fullCardDiagnostic.policy: Exact native full-card reconstruction from the verified 0.4.15 baseline plus the isolated canonical stats footer, including two reviewed original ATQ stat corrections. Existing application index remains separately reported. Local reviewed-credit aggregation includes only scan-verified original credits, with identical weights and eligibility before/after; it is not the hosted score policy. Frozen frame poses and original inputs, ten unresolved scans excluded. Similarity indices are not correctness percentages. The existing application stats crop is narrower than long printed expressions; the separate fitting study covers their full input-derived widths. No change to metric eligibility or region policy is hidden in this report.
